statements.impact_statement: The cli-in-wechat submodule and undici dependency were removed. Runtime WeChat transport imports only node:crypto and uses the Node fetch implementation. Reintroducing cli-in-wechat, undici, proxy initialization, an upstream main entrypoint, router, or adapter registry invalidates this statement and is blocked by CI.
